Proprietary
Comments: 
Regarding: Driver Class Factors 
 
Could you please detail how each Driver Class Factors is determined? 
Response:  Driver Class is a matrix of marital status, gender and age.  There are 4 marital status 
categories:  Married (M), Single (S), Domestic Partnership (P) and Widow(er) (W).  Gender categories 
are Male (M), Female (F) and Not Specified (X).
